name: BACH_0039
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (89%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Invasive probability is 1%; conformal set, second model and neighbors agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 89%, InSitu 9%, Benign 2% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 86th percentile | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated [F3]
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak [F4]
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Small opposing term; one region only · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 3, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable [F2]
- **Dead cell fraction** (regions 3, 9, 10) · context · 97th percentile; direction failed dataset check; sampled regions only · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu holds 9%; the duct-confined concept is Weak (12/20), so low in-situ signal is shaky.
- Cell data cover 3 regions and flag too few tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7**: only slightly positive invasive contribution; confirm they are benign.
2. **Regions 3, 9, 10**: high dead-cell fraction; separate true necrosis from artifact.
3. **Region 1**: strongest atypical-in-duct score; exclude an in-situ component.
